environment.os: Windows workspace with Docker Compose PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO

commands.summary: 149 formatted files, 76 typed source files, 255 backend unit tests, 124 frontend tests, frontend production build
5 live PostgreSQL cases; Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, refusal precision and refusal recall all 1.0

implemented: tenant-scoped Job cancel and manual retry writes
delayed and immediate Outbox retry wakeups
periodic Worker heartbeat, cooperative cancellation, and completion-race protection
separate Celery consumer process with one persistent asyncio event loop
persisted pre-embedding chunks and object-download-free embedding resume
checkpoint corruption rejection and nullable embedding migration
vector-distance, candidate-count, RRF-floor, generation-state, and relational-consistency retrieval gates
real PostgreSQL keyword-only, vector-only, version-isolation, and generation-switch tests
live HybridRetrievalService evaluation rather than prefilled retrieval predictions
limitations: The live evaluation uses controlled eight-dimensional vectors and is not production embedding-quality evidence.
PostgreSQL simple FTS is not evidence of Chinese tokenization quality.
RRF is deterministic fusion; no learned or cross-encoder reranker is implemented.
Citation generation and answer quality are not measured because M4 has not implemented the LLM answer pipeline.
The Celery solo consumer is a real local consumer entrypoint, not a multi-process throughput or production-capacity claim.
M4-M7 remain not implemented on this branch.
